name: I Ching session, step by step
goal: A coaching-style session with one focus

steps.label: (Action) Set one clear focus
steps.note: Without a focus the scan is a melting pot of everything going on in someone's life

steps.label: (Action) Tune in
steps.note: Client holds their focus and feeling

steps.label: Blue Resonance Scan: I Ching
steps.note: Write down every hexagram number in order

steps.label: (Action) Look each hexagram up by number
steps.note: Start with a reading at a glance or a quick-meaning sheet

steps.label: (Action) Turn each into a question and let the client interpret
steps.note: Ask what is this asking of me right now; look for themes that repeat; the meaning is theirs

steps.label: Blue Resonance Scan: I Ching
steps.note: Now with conscious awareness behind them

steps.label: (Action) Follow up
steps.note: Send links for each hexagram or a short summary and reflection questions; avoid long dense PDFs

steps.label: (Action) Add a focus and run the deeper analysis
steps.note: Take the affirmation that resonates into the Coaching app to go deeper

steps.label: (Action) Meditation or program, then vibrate
steps.note: For example an aura-cleanse meditation; do not exceed two to three frequency applications a day

steps.label: (Action) One real-world step
steps.note: Choose one physical action towards the focus

steps.label: Blue Analysis Scanner: Aura Analysis (chakra scan)
steps.timing: Scan again (before bed if doing a morning and evening rhythm)
steps.note: Compare which chakras changed; write results down; patterns matter more than single readings

name: Coaching scan session
goal: One focus, read with the client, deliver, repeat

steps.label: (Action) Wheel of Life and choose categories
steps.note: The eight-area wheel feeds into choosing categories; or turn on every category for a full wheel of life

steps.label: (Action) Client writes their own focus
steps.note: Own words, present tense, one focus per scan; can start from the best affirmation of an Aura scan

steps.label: Blue Analysis Scanner: Coaching Analysis
steps.timing: Run the scan; set readings per category (up to about 20)
steps.note: Read the top six to eight results; use the arrow to drill into sub-areas

steps.label: (Action) Read results together
steps.note: Let the client find their own meaning; green = strengths; D and C easier to shift, LM background; negatives point to deep material; follow results into the next scan if needed

steps.label: Blue Analysis Scanner: Coaching Analysis
steps.timing: Send after the session while the client journals or rests, or three days in a row at an agreed time
steps.note: Short sessions work too; less is more

steps.label: (Action) Repeat later with the same focus
steps.timing: Regularly, and after big life events
steps.note: Tracks progress

steps.label: (Action) Set a focus or goal

steps.timing: Run the analysis (Blue app > Resonance > Healy Program Groups > New Resonance Analysis)
steps.note: Take a photo of the results so you don't keep switching screens

steps.label: (Action) Scan each top category separately
steps.note: Percentages are relative within a scan, not across scans; above 50% is relevant; keep the overview's order

steps.label: (Action) Optional: scan 3 times
steps.note: Results that keep coming back are the person's own; ones that appear and disappear may be picked up from others

steps.label: (Action) Build the list or schedule
steps.note: Run the programs in the Pink app or send them from Lists in the Blue app; if the client lacks a module use the closest program they have

steps.label: (Action) Send frequencies from Lists
steps.note: 8-17 seconds is enough to imprint, a minute is fine, 2:50 per list is typical; for something chronic send once or twice a day
